Alice: Heads-up: upgraded SDK in sample-edge and hit a runtime failure only on Vercel Edge. TS build passes but worker crashes on startup.
Alice: Error:
``
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'request')
    at createClient (node_modules/redwood-inference/dist/index.js:42:18)
```
Alice: Local Node OK. Import used: `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'`.
Ben: Likely default vs named import mismatch. Check esModuleInterop / package fields.
Alice: Tried `import * as Redwood` — different error. TS defs show `createClient<T = unknown>()`.
Carla: Paste tsconfig & package.json main/module? Bundlers + CJS/ESM shapes cause this.
Alice: tsconfig: `esModuleInterop:false`, `allowSyntheticDefaultImports:true`, module ESNext. package.json has `main: dist/index.cjs.js`, `module: dist/index.esm.js`.
Dimitar: Sounds like runtime picks CJS but bundler resolves ESM or vice versa. CJS without `exports.default` -> default import undefined.
Ben: Quick check: inspect bundled output for `exports.createClient` vs `exports.default`.
Alice: Found it: ESM build exports `export function createClient` but CJS build does `module.exports = { createClient }` (no default). Changing to `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference'` fixes runtime.
Carla: Action: sample-app should use named imports for edge. SDK should either add synthetic default in CJS or document parity.
sdk-bot: Known issue: bundler change removed synthetic default in CJS (RFC #321). Workaround: named imports or `esModuleInterop: true`. Tracking ticket internal/SDK-issue-321.
Dimitar: Follow-ups: add CI test that bundles sample-app with both `esModuleInterop` true/false and checks import shapes; add onboarding note about edge import patterns.
Evan: Also saw different retry behavior between hosted fetch and edge-polyfilled fetch due to env detection; that affected error handling. I'll open PR.
Alice: Types question: how to avoid folks using `createClient<any>()` as a band-aid?
Carla: Keep generics as `T = unknown`, provide overloads and ensure exports are named. Avoid `export default` in CJS. Add a small TS smoke test so `createClient()` returns a typed client without explicit any.
Ben: Update quickstart to recommend `esModuleInterop: true` for node users, but note named imports are safest for edge.
Alice: I opened PR in sample-app switching imports to named and added README note.
Carla: I'll add CI that bundles SDK to both CJS+ESM and verifies default vs named shapes.
Evan: Add a small TS assertion test for generic inference.
Ben: Filed follow-ups: RDW-789 (bundle exports), RDW-790 (edge retry parity), RDW-791 (ts typing inference test).
Alice: Marking resolved for sample-app. Thanks! :rocket:
